```{python}
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

# Create a random number generator with a seed
rng = np.random.default_rng(seed=42)

# Create a test 10x3 dataframe
df = pd.DataFrame({
    "A": np.arange(1, 11),
    "B": rng.integers(10, 100, size=10),
    "C": rng.choice(["w", "x", "y", "z"], size=10)
})

print(df)

# Select rows subset
subset = df[df['C'] == 'w']

print("Subset has", len(subset), "rows.")
```
